title: Extended Cech completion reflector properties
statement: For a small ringed site (C,J,O), a finite type ideal module I with monomorphism ι, and an augmented complex K ⟶ O[0] satisfying HasLocalExtendedCechDescription O I ι K ε, the internal-Hom completion functor has locally derived I-complete values, its canonical units are natural, postcomposition with each unit is bijective into every locally derived I-complete target, and the unit is an isomorphism on locally derived I-complete objects.

proof.text: Apply the strictly smaller core theorem for completeness and universal mapping. The private naturality lemma proves the unit naturality clause. The generic unit_isIso_of_complete_universal lemma derives the final isomorphism clause from the core completeness and bijection clauses.
